bridge-type.label: HDL server
bridge-type.description: This bridge represents a HDL server.

parameter.name: ip
parameter.label: Network Address
parameter.description: IP address of the HDL server

channel-type.label: Bus Message Rate
channel-type.description: Average HDL bus message rate over the last update period (see the "busstats" console command for a detailed breakdown).

channel-type.label: Bus Invalid Packet Count
channel-type.description: Total count of unparseable/invalid packets seen since the bridge started.

channel-type.label: Bus Unknown Target Count
channel-type.description: Count of bus addresses that have been sent a command but have never answered on the bus and aren't configured as any Thing - likely a wrong Subnet/DeviceID in the HDL Setup Tool. See BusUnknownTargets for details.

channel-type.label: Bus Unknown Targets
channel-type.description: Bus addresses that have been sent a command but have never answered on the bus and aren't configured as any Thing, each with the real device(s) that sent to it - format "target (from sender1, sender2); ...". Points directly at what to go fix: the target is likely a wrong Subnet/DeviceID in the HDL Setup Tool, and the sender is the physical device/panel whose configuration to correct.
